name: Jack Carroll
bio:
Jack Carroll is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the black and gray realm, creating stunning pieces that embody the essence of realism. With a keen eye for detail, Jack's work is a testament to his exceptional talent within the UK tattoo scene, making him a go-to artist for those seeking lifelike designs etched into their skin. His portfolio, which can be explored on his Facebook page, showcases a diverse range of realistic tattoos, demonstrating his mastery in translating complex ideas into ink.
